name: Shared Setup — Finish Group
intent: Shared setup for a finish_group_assignment pass: floor protection, wall masking (spray only), fixture covers (spray only). Fires ONCE per group regardless of member count. The per-substrate MOD_SETUP_TRIM_PAINT_PROTECT task_refs are gated off via applies_when: { pass_group_id: [null] } so their contribution does not double-count. Mirrors the task list of MOD_SETUP_TRIM_PAINT_PROTECT.
doctrine: V1a finish_group_assignment shared setup. Task_refs mirror MOD_SETUP_TRIM_PAINT_PROTECT exactly so behavior is identical to the current per-substrate setup pattern — the difference is that these fire once per group while per-substrate instances gate off. When non-trim substrates (builtins, stairway, wood_wall, etc.) join a finish_group in V1a, this module's tasks may not match their setup needs perfectly; that mismatch is documented as a V1b issue in the spec.
